body: Phase H2 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md: packages/cli/src/prompt.ts (canAsk, pickTask, sameAs), --no-input and SATI_NO_INPUT, task approve, task send-back, a picker for task show/update/claim when the id is missing and a person is at a terminal.

completion.releaseNote: `sati task approve` and `sati task send-back`; at a terminal, leave the task id out to choose from a list. `--no-input` turns questions off.
completion.summary: H2 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md. New packages/cli/src/prompt.ts: canAsk (person at a terminal, no agent variable, no --json, no SATI_NO_INPUT), pickTask (select up to 10 rows, type-to-filter above, 200 max), askText, Cancelled, sameAs. New `sati task approve [id] [--commit]` and `sati task send-back [id] --reason`, both calling updateTask. `task update`, `task show`, `task claim` offer a list when the id is missing and a person can be asked; scripts, pipes, agents and --json get the same usage errors as before, checked before the project is opened. Global `--no-input` / SATI_NO_INPUT. Gate: lint, typecheck, tests (CLI 255 pass, 3 skipped as before; 10 new in prompt.test.ts incl. stdin-closed 5 s limit and pty cases), 97 Playwright pass. Also unexported the board's unused `today` left by H1.

title: H2: review verbs, task picker, --no-input
